$comment: Example Strategy Engine config. Maps to StrategyEngineConfig in config.ts. Everything except 'mode' is optional.
$comment_mode: conservative | balanced | aggressive | paper_only | strategy_specific | auto. Each preset sets minConfidence + risk thresholds.
$comment_highRiskMode: When true, the engine may trade extreme-volatility regimes (size is still reduced by the risk engine).
$comment_enabledStrategies: 'all' or a list of internalNames, e.g. ['trend_following_v2','breakout_v1','legacy_trend_breakout'].
$comment_disabledStrategies: Force these off regardless of the enabled list.
$comment_includeExperimental: Include experimental strategies (news_event_v1, sentiment_v1, stat_arb_pairs_v1, vwap_intraday_v1). They abstain unless their data inputs are provided.
$comment_minConfidence: Optional override of the mode preset's confidence floor (0-100).
$comment_thresholds: Optional partial override of the mode's risk thresholds.
$comment_manualStrategy: Required only when mode = 'strategy_specific'; the internalName to pin, e.g. 'momentum_v2'.
